operation.name: GetCountyLookupByName
operation.query: select intCountieid as CountyID , intStateid as StateID, CountieCode as CountyCode , CountieName as CountyName from tm_Counties where CountieName = @CountyName

operation.name: GetCountyLookupByID
operation.query: select intCountieid as CountyID , intStateid as StateID, CountieCode as CountyCode , CountieName as CountyName from tm_Counties where intCountieid = @CountyID
